title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue
description: Maurice, a penguin raised in the jungle who thinks he is a tiger, leads a group of misfit animals on missions to rescue their fellow animals, no matter what their trouble is.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x1
episodes_data.description: Professor Ernest, a kiwi, comes to the Jungle Bunch because the earth tremor which has just occurred has opened up a large crack right in the middle of his village! He needs the Jungle Bunch to fix it.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x2
episodes_data.description: Elephants are bullied by a so-called ghost. Hidden behind a rock, the ghost asks them to give him all their fruits as an offering. The Bunch will soon discover that the ghost is just a very special animal - a chameleon.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x3
episodes_data.description: Melina, a former love of Gilbert when he was young, hijacked the rubies of the jungle to create a kind of malefic laser. She wants to take possession of the jungle and the lair of the Jungle Bunch.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x4
episodes_data.description: A beautiful red fruit causes a turtle to go into a deep sleep that's impossible to wake from. Meanwhile, Batricia also discovers the fruit to use as lipstick.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x5
episodes_data.description: Flamingos think horseshoe crabs are aliens bent on invading their lake. Maurice is the only one who can bring peace.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x6
The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x7
episodes_data.description: But who is this Captain Cahouete pretending to be as brave as the Jungle Bunch and challenging the Grand Furax?

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x8
episodes_data.description: Maurice's stripes are wearing away and needs more paint, but the painter doesn't have anymore.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x9
episodes_data.description: Mama Dongo, an old meerkat, calls the Jungle Bunch to the rescue to find out about an itch that is driving the meerkats crazy.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x10
The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x11
episodes_data.description: The Jungle Bunch find themselves trapped in a cage overlooking an island surrounded by hungry crocodiles... Fortunately, Maurice is the master of The Striking Cry.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x12
episodes_data.description: Fred recruits some singers and is taken to the Rock of the Lynx. However, the lynxes want to get rid of him so they can become the only singers of the jungle.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x13
episodes_data.description: Join Maurice the penguin who thinks he's a tiger and his misfit friends as they embark on an adventure they will never forget!

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x14
episodes_data.description: Marla, a crazy botanist, can't control the carnivorous plant she has created and it doesn't stop growing! The Jungle Bunch are sent in to destroy it.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x15
episodes_data.description: Termites have taken possession of the jungle, they destroy the trees and this causes a chain reaction.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Bunch: To the Rescue 1x16
episodes_data.description: Fred has lost his groove and only Pelvis the koala, King of Rock, can help him find it. The only problem is that Pelvis is mostly king of the playback.
